chapter.verse: Ahi zongin sanggamte aw, thu kong gen ciangin Kha Siangtho nei mite' tunga gen bang hilo-in cilesa mite leh Khris sunga naungekte' tunga gen bangin kong gen hi.
Antak haizan zolo na hih manun antak kong pia kei a, nawitui kong tulhzaw hi. Tu-in zong na haizan zo naikei lai uh hi.
Tua pen cilesa mi hi lai na hih man uh ahi hi. Note kikal ah kidemnopna leh kitotna om lai ahih manin note zong cilesa a bulphuh, leitung mihing' zia bang bekin a gamta hilo na hi uh hiam?
A hang pen mi khat in, “Ke'n Paul ka zui,” ci-in a dang khat in, “Ke'n Apollos ka zui,” na cih uh ciangin leitung mihing mawkmawk mah hi lello na hi uh hiam?
Tua ahihleh Apollos bang ahi hiam? Paul bang ahi hiam? Khat tek Topa' seh bangin nomau' thu-up nadinga nasemte ahi uh hi.
Ke'n ankung suanin Apollos in tui buak a, himah taleh Pasian in pungsak khangsak hi.
Tua hi a, a thupi taktak pen a suante leh tuibuakte hilo-in a pungsak a khangsak Pasian ahi hi.
A suante leh tuibuakte pumkhat ahi uh a, amau' sepna zui-in thaman ngah tuak ding uh hi.
Banghanghiam cihleh kote pen Pasian' ading nasemkhawmte ka hi uh a, note pen Pasian' lociing, Pasian' innpum, na hi uh hi.
Kei' tunga hong kiguan Pasian' hehpihna tawh kizui-in innlam siampa bangin khuambul ka phut a, tua tungah a dang khat in lambeh hi. Tua tunga a lambeh mi khat ciat in kidopna tawh sem ta hen.
A hang pen kuamah in Jesu Khris ahi, a kiphutsa khuambul longal a dang phut theilo ding hi.
Tu-in tua khuambul tungah kham, ngun, suangmanpha, sing, bi, buhtu, cihte tawh a lambeh a om leh

khat ciat ii nasep hong kilangkhia ding hi. A hang pen mi khat ciat ii nasep bangci nam cih mei tawh kizia-et ding a, mei in hong pholak ding ahih manin tua Ni ciangin hih thu hong kilang ding ahi hi.
Mi khatpeuh, tua khuambul tunga ama' nasep a kipsuak a om leh pahtakman ngah ding hi.
Mi khatpeuh ama' nasep a kattumleh a thasum hiding a, amah ahihleh hotkhiat ngah sam ding ahih hangin mei pana suakta bang bek hiding hi.
Note Pasian' biakinnpi tau na hihlam uh leh note' sungah Pasian' Kha hong teeng ahihlam thei lo na hi uh hiam?
Mi khatpeuh Pasian' biakinnpi a suksiatleh Pasian in tua mi susia ding hi. A hang pen Pasian' biakinnpi a siangtho hi a, note pen tua biakinnpi na hi uh hi.
Kuamah amahmah kikhemtawm kei hen. Note' lakah khatpeuh hih khanghun sungah pil a kisa a om leh a pil ahih theih nadingin a hai hi phot ta hen.
Banghanghiam cihleh hih leitung pilna pen Pasian' adingin a haihuai thu ahi hi. A hang pen, “Amah in mipilte a zuau khuak mah uh tawh man thei hi,” ci-in kigelh a,
“Mipilte' ngaihsutnate taanglam lo ahihlam Topa in thei hi,” zong kici leuleu hi.
Tua hi a, mihing kimuanna tawh kuamah kisial kei ta hen. A hang pen na khempeuh nomau' a hizaw hi.
Paul ahi-a Apollos leh Cephas ahi zongin, leitung ahi-a nuntakna leh sihna ahi zongin, tu laitak ahi-a mailam ahi zongin, na khempeuh nomau' a ahi hi.
Note zong Khris' a na hi uh a, Khris pen Pasian' a ahi hi.
